title: armeria vulgaris var. halleri
intro: Armeria vulgaris var. halleri, commonly known as Allens cat's ear, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Plumbaginaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Armeria vulgaris var. halleri include wound healing, soothing digestive issues, and reducing fever.
